fusions.name: Two-Way Strand
fusions.desc: Sends a venom bolt into the first enemy it meets, which deals 11 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 4 tiles for 60% of that. Your afflictions on the first target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Split Spit
fusions.desc: Spits 2 beads of venom that split apart out to 6 tiles, each of which deals 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Back Along the Thread
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 45% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Splitting Venom
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, a bolt splits off and deals 6 damage to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles. Once every 5 seconds.
